title: Advanced Admin Panel: TREY C SECURITY dashboard + bulk management, CSV export, and audit log

requirements.summary: Add a dedicated TREY C SECURITY section inside AdminPanelPage with metrics, recent events, and admin controls wired via React Query.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin panel includes a clearly labeled "TREY C SECURITY" area (tab/section) using the existing cyber admin theme styles.

The security area renders: (1) KPI cards/counters, (2) a recent-events table/list, (3) blocklist/allowlist management UI, and (4) configuration controls; all wired to backend endpoints via React Query hooks.
All security actions show success/error toasts and update the displayed data via query invalidation/refetch.
Non-admin users still cannot access the admin panel (AdminGate behavior unchanged).

file_operations.description: Extend React Query key helpers to include stable query keys for TREY C SECURITY (stats/config/events) so the admin UI can invalidate/refetch after security mutations.

Create a React Query hook that fetches TREY C SECURITY aggregated counters (allowed/denied/throttled) from the backend actor and supports refetching/invalidation. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a React Query hook that fetches recent TREY C SECURITY events (with a limit param) for rendering in an admin table/list. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a React Query hook to fetch current TREY C SECURITY configuration (enabled flag, thresholds, allow/blocklist sizes) for the admin controls UI. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create React Query mutation hooks for TREY C SECURITY admin controls (toggle enabled, update rate limits, clear/reset counters, add/remove principals to allowlist/blocklist) with automatic query invalidation and toast-friendly error propagation. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement a TREY C SECURITY admin section component that renders KPI cards, a recent events table/list, and configuration + allowlist/blocklist management controls using existing shadcn/ui components (do not edit frontend/src/components/ui). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add an in-page navigation (tab/section switch) to include a clearly labeled "TREY C SECURITY" area and render TreyCSecuritySection; wire to the new hooks, show success/error toasts, and invalidate/refetch security queries after actions (AdminGate behavior remains unchanged). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Enhance the admin panel with bulk order actions, CSV export of filtered orders, and an admin audit log view.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can select multiple orders and apply bulk actions with confirmation prompts; UI clearly shows progress and per-action outcomes.
Admin can export the currently filtered order list to a CSV file from the UI (frontend-generated CSV is acceptable).
Backend records critical admin actions in an audit log that is admin-readable; admin panel provides a view to browse/filter recent audit entries.
Existing single-order actions continue to work as before.

file_operations.description: Add React Query keys for admin audit log queries (and any bulk-operation-related invalidations) to keep cache management consistent across admin tools.

Create React Query mutation hooks for bulk order actions (approve/ship/delete) that call backend bulk functions, track progress state suitable for per-order outcome UI, and invalidate order queries on success/failure. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a React Query hook to fetch the admin audit log (with a limit param) for display in the admin panel, with filtering handled client-side. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add a utility to generate and trigger download of a CSV for the currently filtered orders list (including key order fields); ensure safe escaping/quoting and a deterministic filename.

Create an Audit Log section component that renders a searchable/filterable list/table of recent audit entries using existing shadcn/ui components (do not edit frontend/src/components/ui) and the useAuditLog hook. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a bulk-actions toolbar component for the orders list (selection count, actions: approve/ship/delete, confirmation prompts, progress/outcome display) that integrates with the bulk action hooks and order query invalidation. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add multi-select UI to the existing orders list (without breaking single-order actions), render BulkOrderActionsBar, add a CSV export button that exports the currently filtered list via exportOrdersCsv, and add an Audit Log section/view wired to useAuditLog.
